name: shoresh
description: Read and change your camp's Shoresh schedules, as you, with your own Salesforce sign-in.
long_description: Shoresh is a day-camp scheduling app in Salesforce. This extension lets Claude read your camp's schedules, bring in campers and groups, and change a schedule cell, as you and with exactly your access in Salesforce. The first time, your browser opens at Salesforce's sign-in page. It needs the Salesforce command line on this computer.

salesforce_address.title: Your camp's Salesforce address
salesforce_address.description: Only if signing in at login.salesforce.com doesn't work for your camp, like camp.my.salesforce.com.
